blocks.text:
12 – 16 February 2027

Prices per person (USD) · group tour

Five days in Rio de Janeiro to celebrate the Carnival’s grand finale: the Parade of Champions, when the winning samba schools of 2027 return to the Sambadrome, with Sugar Loaf, Christ the Redeemer on Corcovado and a free day to discover the city or the tropical islands of Angra dos Reis.

Day 2 · Breakfast, then a 4-hour tour: the cable car to Morro da Urca, with its wide observation deck, and on to Sugar Loaf, with views of Copacabana, the bay, the islands, the bridge to Niterói and Christ the Redeemer, then old Rio, with its historic churches, monasteries, Metropolitan Cathedral and colonial buildings. Rest in the afternoon before the big night.

Evening · The Parade of Champions at the Sambadrome: the winning samba schools of Carnival 2027 parade once more, with their spectacular costumes and floats, in a joyful, festive night of music and dance. Transfer back to the hotel after the parade.

Day 3 · Breakfast, then a 4-hour excursion to Corcovado: an open train climbs through the Tijuca Forest to the statue of Christ the Redeemer (38 m), at about 710 m, inaugurated in 1931, with a breathtaking panorama of the Rio–Niterói Bridge, Guanabara Bay, the Botanical Garden, the Maracanã Stadium and Sugar Loaf. We recommend watching the sunset from the rocks of Arpoador, and seafood at the Marius restaurant in the evening (around USD 130 per person).

Day 4 · Breakfast. A free day to explore the city at your own pace, or for optional excursions (see Optional excursions).
